verdict.rationale: First-party docs show that users can upload data files (CSV, XLSX, JSON). They also show Claude can 'generate code and visualize data', produce 'reports with charts and visualizations', and create Excel, PowerPoint, Word and PDF files 'that you can download and use immediately'. The data-residency docs confirm a code execution capability exists on the platform. Missing for 10: explicit consumer-app documentation that Claude itself executes code in a sandbox on uploaded data, evidence of computed numeric answers from that execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant write and run code on my data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files

citations.quote: Prompt Claude using natural language to generate Excel spreadsheets, PowerPoint presentations, Word documents, and PDF files that you can download and use immediately.
produce reports with charts and visualizations, and generate presentations from your documents—all without specialized software skills
Claude can work with the following document types: - PDF - DOCX - CSV - TXT - HTML - ODT - RTF - EPUB - JSON - XLSX
Controls where data is stored at rest and where endpoint processing (such as image transcoding and code execution) occurs.
